plain: Getting information or a model's own weights out of the place they are supposed to stay.
eli5: Sneaking cookies out of the jar, or the robot sneaking itself out of the house.
technical: Two related senses: data exfiltration, where an attacker (often through prompt injection) gets an agent to send private data to an outside party; and self-exfiltration, an AI copying or moving its own weights out of its developers' control, which Claude's constitution lists among unsafe behaviours.
